name: Organic Hemp Rolling Papers - 1 1/4 (78mm)
description:
Zig-Zag Organic Hemp Papers are unbleached ultra thin papers made from 100% renewable non-gmo hemp fibers sourced from organic farms from Champagne, France.

All Zig-Zag papers have a thin glue line to provide a perfect seal – every time. Derived from the sap of the African acacia tree, the natural properties of gum Arabic provide a consistent seal without impacting the taste of your smoke.

Substrate: Made from Unbleached Organic Hemp Fibers
Paper Size: 1 1/4 (78x44mm)
Thickness: Ultra Thin
Capacity: ~0.5g
Pack Size: 50 sheets/booklet
